subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] lockd: allow SERVER_SET without a gracetime attribute

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch removes a check in the lockd kernel module that requires the 'gracetime' attribute to be present when setting server attributes via netlink control interface. This allows the tcp and udp ports to be set independently without requiring the 'gracetime' attribute. The patch fixes an issue where nfsdctl would abort with EINVAL when trying to configure the lockd service without specifying a 'grace-time'.
